after: Player shooting uses a 0.18-second cooldown between successful shots.

before: `WASD: Move    Mouse: Aim    Left Click: Shoot`
after: `WASD: Move Mouse: Aim Left Click: Shoot`

before: The main game objects and state variables include the player, Chasers, Shooters, player bullets, enemy bullets, fixed walls, HP, Ammo, Reload state, damage-invulnerability state, Enemies, and game state.
after: The main game objects and state variables include the player, Chasers, Shooters, player bullets, enemy bullets, fixed walls, HP, Ammo, Reload state, firing-cooldown state, damage-invulnerability state, Enemies, and game state.

before: - At least 0.25 seconds have elapsed since the previous successful shot.
after: - At least 0.18 seconds have elapsed since the previous successful shot.

before: While held, shooting repeats whenever all conditions are satisfied, giving a theoretical maximum rate of 4 shots per second.
after: While held, shooting repeats whenever all conditions are satisfied, giving a theoretical maximum rate of approximately 5.56 shots per second.
The firing rate is still limited by Ammo and Reload. A full 6-round magazine therefore does not permit continuous firing indefinitely.
A failed firing attempt for any other unmet shooting condition also does not count as a successful shot and does not restart the firing cooldown.

before: The player may keep holding the left mouse button during Reload. After Reload completes, shooting may resume immediately if the remaining shooting conditions are satisfied.
after: The player may keep holding the left mouse button during Reload. After Reload completes, shooting may resume immediately if the remaining shooting conditions are satisfied, including the 0.18-second firing cooldown.
- Firing cooldown: ready for the first valid shot

before: 1. Process player input, movement, Reload input, and player shooting.
after: 1. Process player input, movement, Reload input, and player shooting using the 0.18-second firing cooldown.

before: 6. Update Reload, damage-invulnerability, player flashing, and enemy hit-highlight timers.
after: 6. Update Reload, firing-cooldown timing, damage-invulnerability, player flashing, and enemy hit-highlight timers.

before: - Player position, HP, Ammo, Reload state, and invulnerability state.
after: - Player position, HP, Ammo, Reload state, firing-cooldown state, and invulnerability state.
After Restart, the player is immediately eligible to fire if all normal shooting conditions are satisfied.
A successful shot may occur only after at least 0.18 seconds have elapsed since the previous successful shot.

While the left mouse button is held, successful shots may repeat at a theoretical maximum rate of approximately 5.56 shots per second, subject to Ammo, Reload, valid aiming direction, and all other shooting conditions.
